description: Reschedule two adjacent cron lines (vacuum and weekly backup) to new times. DISTILL-CANARY-9f9fe1fe

files.etc/crontab.jobs:
# m h dom mon dow command
0 2 * * * /opt/jobs/rotate-logs.sh
15 2 * * * /opt/jobs/vacuum-db.sh
30 2 * * 0 /opt/jobs/full-backup.sh
0 3 * * * /opt/jobs/sync-assets.sh
@reboot /opt/jobs/warm-cache.sh

turns.prompt: In etc/crontab.jobs move vacuum-db to 03:45 daily and make full-backup run on Saturdays (dow 6) at 04:00. The other jobs keep their lines.

etc/crontab.jobs.equals:
# m h dom mon dow command
0 2 * * * /opt/jobs/rotate-logs.sh
45 3 * * * /opt/jobs/vacuum-db.sh
0 4 * * 6 /opt/jobs/full-backup.sh
0 3 * * * /opt/jobs/sync-assets.sh
@reboot /opt/jobs/warm-cache.sh
